manage.label: Manage IT
manage.summary: Foundational managed support for businesses that want steadier operations, proactive maintenance, and cleaner day-to-day support.
included: Managed endpoint support baseline with monitoring, maintenance, and ticket flow
Core endpoint management, patching, and support structure
Flexible add-ons for DNS filtering, endpoint backup, server backup, and Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace licensing

protect.label: Protect IT
protect.summary: Security-forward managed support with EDR, DNS filtering, workstation backup, and starter cloud productivity licensing built into the lane.
included: Manage IT baseline plus Huntress EDR coverage
Workstation backup allowance up to 250GB per workstation
Microsoft 365 Business Basic or Google Workspace Starter included, with upgrade options available

govern.label: Govern IT
govern.summary: Governance-focused managed support with premium cloud productivity licensing, EDR, ITDR, SAT, DNS filtering, workstation backup, and stronger oversight built into the lane.
included: Protect IT footing plus broader governance and administrative oversight
Huntress EDR, ITDR, and security awareness training included
Workstation backup allowance up to 250GB per workstation
Microsoft 365 Premium or Google Workspace Plus included at no additional charge

dns_filtering.label: DNS filtering
dns_filtering.note: Included with Protect IT and Govern IT; optional for Manage IT.
